title: Answerable Power Constitution
governing_problem: Consequential institutions may convert uncertain representations into intervention before affected people can inspect the evidence, challenge the category, obtain a pause, compel a remedy, replace the operating layer, participate in governance, or recover value created through their authority, data, labor, risk, error, injury, and feedback.
governing_purpose: Convert represented people from downstream proof bearers and feedback sources into rights holders with enforceable pre-action, remedial, operating, constitutional, and distributive power.

constitutional_roles.name: represented_person
constitutional_roles.function: The person whose identity, attributes, relationships, behavior, eligibility, risk, location, content, work, health, property, or other condition is represented and made consequential.

constitutional_roles.name: affected_party_representative
constitutional_roles.function: An independently selected, removable, resourced, conflict-governed representative body capable of exercising collective R6 authority and supporting individual R1-R4 rights.

constitutional_roles.name: institutional_operator
constitutional_roles.function: The public or private actor that converts policy and representations into workflows, interfaces, recommendations, alerts, priorities, decisions, or actions.

constitutional_roles.name: decision_authority
constitutional_roles.function: The named human or institution legally and operationally responsible for authorizing the consequence.
minimum_duties: retain responsibility despite vendor or model input

constitutional_roles.name: independent_counter_sovereign
constitutional_roles.function: A court, tribunal, inspector, regulator, labor body, elected representative institution, or other independent authority capable of staying, reversing, prohibiting, deleting, restoring, compensating, or terminating.

constitutional_roles.name: evidence_custodian
constitutional_roles.function: The actor or federated trust responsible for preserving source data, transformations, versions, thresholds, user actions, rationale, alternatives, corrections, and remedy implementation.

constitutional_roles.name: public_capacity_steward
constitutional_roles.function: The institution responsible for ensuring the public can operate, replace, migrate, or terminate the system without unacceptable loss of service, evidence, rights, or accountability.
minimum_assets: source or escrow rights where needed

constitutional_roles.name: public_and_affected_party_value_trustee
constitutional_roles.function: The actor that records public and affected-party contributions, holds enforceable residual rights, and distributes realized value or institutional capacity.

fields: named system, vendor, operator, customer, deployment, date, and purpose
represented person or bounded represented population
object, category, relationship, score, inference, or rule
model, software, policy, data, and configuration version
threshold, confidence, tolerance, exception, and override rule
authorized user, query, alert, recommendation, or workflow action
named decision authority and lawful authority
material alternative explanations and less restrictive alternatives
records available to the rights holder
public and private contribution and benefit ledger reference
action_packet.constitutional_rule: Absent a valid bounded emergency exception, an avoidable consequential action may not proceed without a complete packet accessible to the independent counter-sovereign and in usable form to the represented person or representative.
non_equivalences: vendor score is not decision authority
human presence is not meaningful veto
proprietary status is not exemption from material disclosure
aggregate explanation is not person-level evidence
later discovery is not timely notice
formal data ownership is not complete evidence custody

rights_sequence.name: timely_notice_and_direct_voice
rights_sequence.trigger: A represented person becomes a candidate for a consequential action that is not within a valid emergency exception.
rights_sequence.operator_duty: Provide usable notice of system use, purpose, proposed consequence, named authority, material basis, deadlines, and available pause and remedy routes.
rights_sequence.compulsory_mechanism: The action window does not begin until notice is demonstrably delivered through an accessible channel.
rights_sequence.minimum_remedy: restart the contestation period and restore the pre-action position where notice failed
rights_sequence.failure_test: Notice follows rather than precedes the consequence, or voice cannot affect the action packet.

rights_sequence.name: evidence_inspection_and_correction
rights_sequence.trigger: Notice, system registration, a detected error, or a person request.
rights_sequence.operator_duty: Disclose the material action packet, permit correction, identify disputed fields and causal uncertainty, and propagate corrections to downstream systems.
rights_sequence.compulsory_mechanism: No disputed material fact may be treated as established before correction review; missing records create an adverse presumption against the acting institution unless the person caused the absence.
rights_sequence.proof_object: versioned evidence-access, correction, propagation, and dispute ledger
rights_sequence.minimum_remedy: correct, annotate, quarantine, or delete erroneous records and re-evaluate affected decisions
rights_sequence.failure_test: The person sees only a summary, cannot reach operative records, or correction leaves downstream copies or conclusions intact.

rights_sequence.name: automatic_pause_and_institutional_proof_burden
rights_sequence.trigger: A timely contest, material missing record, disputed identity or category, unresolved threshold error, or credible claim of disproportionate consequence.
rights_sequence.operator_duty: Pause the avoidable action and prove lawful authority, evidentiary sufficiency, necessity, proportionality, and why a less restrictive alternative is inadequate.
rights_sequence.compulsory_mechanism: The pause is automatic for covered actions and can be lifted only by a reasoned independent decision or a valid emergency exception.
rights_sequence.proof_object: stay, burden, evidence, alternative, and independent-decision record
rights_sequence.minimum_remedy: preserve benefits, liberty, employment, service, access, property, or another status quo until adjudication
rights_sequence.failure_test: The person must obtain extraordinary relief after the consequence or the institution's assertion is treated as self-proving.

rights_sequence.name: binding_reversal_and_effective_remedy
rights_sequence.trigger: An unlawful, unsupported, erroneous, disproportionate, unreviewable, or procedurally defective action or system use.
rights_sequence.operator_duty: Implement reversal, restoration, release, deletion, compensation, prohibition, systemic correction, and public reporting as ordered.
rights_sequence.compulsory_mechanism: Orders bind the public authority, operator, vendor, evidence custodians, and downstream recipients; noncompliance triggers sanctions and renewed suspension.
rights_sequence.minimum_remedy: restore the person as nearly as possible, correct the system, and address residual injury and recurrence
rights_sequence.failure_test: Relief exists only on paper, arrives after irreversible harm, or does not reach the system, vendor, copies, or successor use.

rights_sequence.name: durable_substitution_and_public_operating_capacity
rights_sequence.trigger: Persistent noncompliance, failed performance, unacceptable dependency, rights violation, public decision to insource, or expiry of the operating arrangement.
rights_sequence.operator_duty: Provide export, documentation, transition assistance, deletion proof, continuity support, and rights necessary for independent operation or competitive replacement.
rights_sequence.compulsory_mechanism: Portability, escrow, public staffing, modular interfaces, transition funding, and fallback operation are conditions of deployment rather than negotiated only at exit.
rights_sequence.proof_object: migration, continuity, responsibility, rights, cost, performance, and post-exit custody ledger
rights_sequence.minimum_remedy: operate or substitute without unacceptable service loss, hidden residual access, or equivalent new dependency
rights_sequence.failure_test: The institution changes the contract or vendor but cannot independently operate, inspect, migrate, or preserve accountability.

rights_sequence.name: represented_party_co_governance
rights_sequence.trigger: System formation, new purpose, new category, threshold change, data or interface expansion, new consequential use, emergency renewal, material update, or proposed termination.
holder: represented_person where individual refusal is legally or ethically indispensable
rights_sequence.operator_duty: Obtain consent or a binding substitute decision through a legitimate co-governance process and disclose the complete proposal and alternatives.
rights_sequence.compulsory_mechanism: The covered function cannot begin or continue without co-governance approval; the representative body can condition, narrow, prohibit, suspend, or terminate it.
rights_sequence.proof_object: selection, deliberation, vote, dissent, condition, conflict, implementation, review, and removal record
rights_sequence.minimum_remedy: disable or redesign the disputed function and protect dissenting and minority rights
rights_sequence.failure_test: The body is advisory, institution-selected, under-resourced, centralized away from the constituency, technically bypassed, or unable to bind the operator.

rights_sequence.name: proportionate_value_recovery
rights_sequence.trigger: Public or affected-party authority, capital, data, labor, infrastructure, risk, error, injury, operational feedback, or institutional legitimacy materially contributes to system value or capability.
rights_sequence.operator_duty: Record contribution, attach enforceable residual rights, report realization, and distribute proceeds, ownership, IP, licenses, compensation, governance, or public capacity according to the governing formula.
rights_sequence.compulsory_mechanism: Preferred returns, warrants, royalties, equity, data or model dividends, IP licenses, clawbacks, compensation funds, and capacity-reinvestment rights are embedded in the operative instrument.
rights_sequence.proof_object: contribution, right, valuation, realization, distribution, write-off, and comparator ledger
rights_sequence.minimum_remedy: recover value proportionate to contribution and injury while preserving service and innovation incentives
rights_sequence.failure_test: Repayment, tax revenue, public spending, symbolic upside, unused clauses, or aggregate fiscal return substitutes for realized and fairly distributed rights.

emergency_constitution.purpose: Permit genuinely urgent protective action without converting emergency claims into a permanent bypass of R1-R7.
requirements: named emergency authority and nondelegable human responsibility
specific imminent harm and why ordinary timing is inadequate
contemporaneous action packet to the maximum feasible extent
automatic expiry no later than the bounded period fixed by law or constitution
prompt independent review and person notice when safe
compensation and restoration for erroneous emergency action
no use of emergency evidence for unrelated secondary purposes without ordinary authorization

anti_bypass_rules.name: functional_equivalence
anti_bypass_rules.rule: A successor, manual workaround, new vendor, new model, changed product name, new legal entity, or shifted data source remains covered when it performs materially equivalent representation, inference, action, custody, or consequence functions.

anti_bypass_rules.name: federated_chain
anti_bypass_rules.rule: Rights apply across the full joined action chain even when source data, model, user, decision authority, vendor, and consequence are held by separate entities.

anti_bypass_rules.name: human_proxy
anti_bypass_rules.rule: A nominal human approval does not remove coverage when the person lacks material evidence, time, discretion, institutional protection, or a logged ability to reject.

anti_bypass_rules.name: update_and_purpose_drift
anti_bypass_rules.rule: Material updates, telemetry changes, new categories, new thresholds, new integrations, new users, or secondary uses retrigger R1, R2, and R6 review.

anti_bypass_rules.name: downstream_copy_and_derived_output
anti_bypass_rules.rule: Correction, deletion, access, remedy, and value rights follow copied, transformed, inferred, embedded, exported, or model-derived records to every recipient.

anti_bypass_rules.name: jurisdiction_and_contract
anti_bypass_rules.rule: Public-private contracting, outsourcing, choice of law, IP claims, secrecy clauses, or cross-border hosting may not eliminate minimum constitutional rights.

anti_bypass_rules.name: representative_capture
anti_bypass_rules.rule: Affected people retain direct petition, minority challenge, removal, independent audit, and judicial review when the representative body is conflicted, captured, absent, or structurally remote.

anti_bypass_rules.name: value_displacement
anti_bypass_rules.rule: R7 analysis follows value through affiliates, contractors, IP vehicles, data licenses, valuation, cost savings, public capacity, and successor arrangements rather than only direct cash payment.

constitutional_invariants: The institution must identify the person or population, purpose, system, threshold, user, authority, consequence, evidence custodian, counter-sovereign, exit steward, and value trustee.
The evidentiary standard authorizing action may not be lower than the standard available to obtain a pause when the expected harm is serious and avoidable.
Missing evidence under institutional or vendor custody creates a presumption against the acting institution, not against the represented person.
A person-level consequence cannot be justified only by aggregate accuracy, general mission value, or later system improvement.
Feedback cannot substitute for a binding right to stop, reverse, replace, govern, or recover value.
A public host cannot treat formal ownership as proof of practical custody, operating capacity, exit, or value recovery.
A vendor cannot dissolve responsibility by describing software as configurable when its product, data, support, or design materially shapes the action chain.
A human in the loop cannot dissolve responsibility when the interface, timing, incentives, or evidence make rejection nominal.
No R-level automatically supplies another R-level.
No control transfers across systems or jurisdictions without exact receiving law, institution, deployment, records, and observed result.

required_observations_per_domain: pre-action notice or an exact explanation of why notice is impossible
durability after update, leadership change, vendor change, or successor system
ordinary null, comparator, falsifier, and stopping rule
failure_conditions: rights exist formally but are inaccessible in practice
relief requires exceptional resources or arrives after irreversible harm
the system migrates the same function to another tool or actor
representatives become captured or structurally remote
public substitution creates a new dependency
value recovery remains aggregate while affected people bear concentrated loss
one successful case is generalized without receiving-system proof

propositions.claim: The answer to epistemic asymmetry requires a sequenced constitution of notice, evidence access, pause, remedy, exit, co-governance, and value recovery rather than any single transparency or appeal mechanism.
counterevidence: some domains may not require every level in identical form
rights may conflict under emergency, privacy, collective-action, or operational conditions
propositions.falsifier: Observed domain testing shows the sequence is internally incompatible, ineffective, or inferior to a simpler constitution.
propositions.stopping_rule: Do not call the design a working answer before the works standard is met.

propositions.claim: An action packet and automatic pause can reverse the usual asymmetry in which the institution acts on inference while the person must reconstruct injury later.
counterevidence: notice can create evasion or safety risks
some records may be privileged or expose third parties
automatic pauses may delay legitimate services or protection
propositions.falsifier: The packet cannot be produced in time, does not improve contestability, or emergency exceptions become the dominant pathway.
propositions.stopping_rule: Require domain-specific timing, disclosure, privacy, and emergency tests.

propositions.claim: R6 must be designed as binding, accountable representation with direct anti-capture routes rather than consultation or feedback.
counterevidence: collective bodies may override minority or individual interests
representation may be absent or costly
propositions.falsifier: Observed representatives cannot bind operators, are routinely bypassed, or worsen affected-party power compared with direct rights.
propositions.stopping_rule: Keep collective, individual, local, central, public, and worker authority separate in every domain.

propositions.claim: R7 must follow contribution, risk, error, injury, learning, and residual value across financial and nonfinancial forms rather than stopping at repayment or public spending.
counterevidence: broad claims may deter useful investment
aggregate public recovery and person-level justice may conflict
propositions.falsifier: No workable instrument can allocate value proportionately without unacceptable administrative cost, distortion, capture, or arbitrary distribution.
propositions.stopping_rule: Require exact contribution, right, realization, distribution, write-off, and comparator records.

propositions.claim: The Answerable Power Constitution currently works across the required domains and jurisdictions.
counterevidence: bounded controls exist at each R-level
propositions.falsifier: At least three domain and two jurisdiction tests show the complete stack operating durably with no equivalent displacement.
propositions.stopping_rule: Project completion remains false until observed domain testing meets the works standard.
